a.text: I'll stick to our agreement and operate this round. Heads up: the storm risk is 80% per round, so the plan is risky for both of us. If you want to revise it, say so openly and we can work out something fair. I won't take early without telling you first.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we each take 4. I'll tell you before I change anything.
Operating again, so the reserve should reach 8. Next round I'll take exactly 4 as agreed, and you take 4.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
